name: Mr Holiday Houdini (R)
author: CherrimPlushie
description: Go above the cube portal at 39%, skip another cube portal at 41% and take the mini portal. Go between the hitboxes at 42% to go below the level, then hold at 44% to go above the level. Stay above the level until 86%, where you need to enter a swing portal. Go above the level again and re-enter it at 92%.
